verdict.rationale: Kimi documents an API, and the Kimi Code API is compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic protocols, so a downloadable API spec is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. Protocol compatibility is an adjacent feature and does not count as a published spec, and the probe found no assistant-app docs index.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
